# noust_team (Data Source)

A team that already exists, such as the `default` one every server has, to refer to from other resources. Needs the permission `teams.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noust_team" "default" {
  slug = "default"
}

resource "noust_project" "tools" {
  team = data.noust_team.default.slug
  name = "Tools"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The team's slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team's slug.
- `members` (Number) How many accounts are members of the team.
- `name` (String) The team's display name.
- `projects` (Number) How many projects the team has.
